flagged.evidence: Step 3.1 says, “By [F3], ∫₀∞|u|² = Σₙ∫_{Eₙ}|u|²,” where Eₙ=[xₙ,xₙ+δ) are pairwise disjoint but are not shown to cover [0,∞). Countable additivity gives the integral over their union; the total integral is only known to be at least that sum. Replacing equality by ≥ still yields the intended contradiction, so this is nonfatal.

Current [F2] says “moreover for ℏ,m>0” the scaled operator has ψα as an eigenvector, without explicitly restricting this trailing clause to α<0. The current dependency thm-nrqm-intervals-delta-unique-bound-state, clause (c), licenses that scaled eigenpair only “if α<0”; at α=0 the displayed ψα is zero, not an eigenvector. The consumer proof uses the scaled eigenpair only for g<0, so its conclusions remain supported; [F2] should state the condition explicitly.
